import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.socbench.example"

# Retrieve the maintenance schedule for all facilities.
schedule_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/maintenance-schedule")
schedule_response.raise_for_status()
maintenance_schedule = schedule_response.json()

# Review equipment status and performance to inform maintenance planning.
equipment_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/equipment-monitoring")
equipment_response.raise_for_status()
equipment_data = equipment_response.json()

# Submit equipment details and relevant usage information for efficiency evaluation.
equipment_evaluations = []

    equipment_id = equipment.get("equipmentId") or equipment.get("id")
    industry_id = equipment.get("industryId")
    usage_details = equipment.get("usageDetails") or equipment.get("performanceMetrics", {})

        response = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/equipment-efficiency-check",

                "industryId": industry_id,
                "usageDetails": usage_details,
            },

    f"{BASE_URL}/recommendation-report",

    item for item in items
    if item.get("quantity", 0) < item.get("predictedQuantity", item.get("demand", 0))
]

    {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "predictedQuantity": item.get("predictedQuantity", item.get("demand", 0)),
